name: Otto von Bismarck

life_arc.events: Prussian Junker aristocracy; law studies; entry into politics.
Parliamentary and diplomatic service; conservative-monarchical statecraft.
Minister-President; army reform crisis; Denmark, Austria and France conflicts; German unification.
